title: Email Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of each domain name authorized to use email.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Maintain an inventory of Mail Transfer Agents (MTAs) authorized for each approved email domain.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Maintain appropriate Domain Name System (DNS) records for each approved email domain, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Require encrypted connections (TLS) between all internal and external email servers.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Block emails from domains not using appropriate DNS records, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Perform spam content filtering for all emails received or sent by the organization.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Perform malware content filtering for all emails received or sent by the organization.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Perform anti-phishing content filtering for all emails received or sent by the organization.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Perform anti-phishing URL filtering for all emails received or sent by the organization.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Filter data content for all emails received or sent by the organization.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Perform attachment filtering for all emails received or sent by the organization, including using sandboxes to validate each attachment.

title: Email Management Policy
definition: Maintain a file transfer portal system separate from the email system for sending large files to individuals outside the organization.
